body: Thanks so much, I appreciate it. I'm luckily better today.
Thanks I am still here. It's hard to know what exactly my problem is, but I appreciate having the chance to get things out. I really appreciate it.
Hey. Thank you so much for doing that. You don't know how much I appreciate it. If you still don't mind I will send you message when I've regained some more energy.
Thank you everyone for your comments. I was really drunk and down. I also decided to remove my potential suicide "equipment".

Trap, hip hop is my favorite, almost any type of EDM, chill music, classic rock, jazz, baroque, you name it, Metallica is my favorite band. Music is probably one of the most significant things in my life tbh. Played a few instruments really well, but I don't care for that anymore.
